changelog.summary: Aligned public headings, labels, and accessibility names with the canonical UI casing contract.
Moved content-section counting and viewport scope into the executable delight policy so public guidance cannot drift from the evaluator.
Preserved sticky-header contrast over logo and token specimens after mobile anchor testing.
Improved public intentionality labels and anchored-section clearance after real desktop and mobile rendered review.
Locked delight counts as optional maximums, added no-budget-filling receipts, hardened private media projection, and attached the Brand System check to builds and CI.
Established the generated public Brand System projection, versioned asset checksums, approved composition examples, privacy boundary, and executable drift gate.
